# calced: instructions for LLM agents

calced is a notepad calculator at https://sjev.github.io/calced/
The user types plain text. Each line that is a full expression shows a result
on the right. All other lines are prose and show nothing.

Your task is usually: write a calced document for the user, then give a link.

# Link format

Give the user this link:

https://sjev.github.io/calced/?text=PERCENT_ENCODED_DOCUMENT

Encode the document with encodeURIComponent rules:
space is %20, newline is %0A, plus is %2B, hash is %23, equals is %3D,
slash is %2F, percent is %25, ampersand is %26.
Do not encode a space as a plus sign.
Example: the document "a = 2" then "a + 1" is ?text=a%20%3D%202%0Aa%20%2B%201

# Rules

A line computes only when the parser uses every token. One unknown word or
stray character makes the whole line prose. calced does not repair a line.
Write one calculation per line. Put the label in a comment after the hash.
Do not use a comma in a number. Write 1000 or 1_000, not 1,000.
A blank line ends a block. sum() adds only the lines above it in its block.
Variable names are letters, digits and underscores. Assign them before use.
Define a currency rate with @rate before you convert that currency.
The only calls with no arguments are date(), now() and sum().
In this file, the text after the result marker is the output of calced.
Do not write result markers in your document. calced makes them.

# Operators

2 + 3 * 4                               # =>    14
2 ** 10                                 # => 1_024
7 // 2                                  # =>     3
17 % 5                                  # =>     2

# Variables and totals

rent = 1200                             # => 1_200
food = 450                              # =>   450
rent + food                             # => 1_650

3.50                                    # bread  # =>  3.5  │
2 * 1.20                                # milk   # =>  2.4  │
4.95                                    # eggs   # =>  4.95 │
groceries = sum()                                # => 10.85 ┘

# Percentages

price = 80                              # => 80
price + 21%                             # => 96.8
price - 10%                             # => 72
15% of price                            # => 12
20 as % of price                        # => 25

# Units and SI prefixes

Units: mm cm m km in ft yd mi, mg g kg oz lb, C F K,
b kb mb gb tb kib mib gib tib, ms s min hr day week,
ml l tsp tbsp floz pt qt gal. Use in or to for a conversion.
SI suffixes: k M G for large, m u for small.

5 km in miles                           # =>      3.106855961
100 C in F                              # =>    212
2.5k * 4                                # => 10_000

# Currencies

@rate USD/EUR = 0.92
100 USD in EUR                          # => 92

# Functions and constants

sqrt abs floor ceil log log2 log10 exp sin cos tan asin acos atan
round(x, digits) min(a, b) max(a, b), and the constants pi e tau.

round(2 * pi * 3, 2)                    # => 18.85
max(3, 9, 4)                            # =>  9

# Dates

date() is today and now() is the current time.

2025-01-15 + 3 days                     # => 2025-01-18
2025-03-01 - 2025-01-01                 # => 59
2025-01-15 18:00 - 2025-01-15 09:00     # =>  9

# Output format

@format = fixed(2)
1234.5                                  # => 1_234.50
@separator = comma
1234.5                                  # => 1,234.50

Format modes: minSig, fixed, scientific, eng and auto.
Separators: underscore, comma, space and off.

# Full reference

https://sjev.github.io/calced/docs.md
